description.p: Your draconic heritage has been severed and devoured by the Void. What remains is something colder, deeper, and profoundly unnatural. The Weave recoils from you… but the Void answers.
You gain darkvision out to 120 feet.
You can speak, read, and write Draconic.
Void Disdain: When interacting with dragons, you cannot benefit from proficiency bonuses on Charisma checks.

sheet.description: Darkvision 120 ft. You know Draconic. Disadvantage interacting with dragons (no proficiency bonus to CHA checks).

description.p: Your hit point maximum increases by 1 per sorcerer level.
When not wearing armour, your AC equals 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

sheet.description: When you aren’t wearing armor, your AC equals {{ac:void resilience}}.

description.p: You learn the Darkness spell; it does not count against your spells known.
You can cast it using sorcery points.
You can see through your Darkness a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

sheet.description: You learn the Darkness spell. You can cast it using sorcery points. When you cast Darkness using sorcery points, you can see through it. Usable PB times per long rest.

description.p: Add CHA modifier to one cold damage roll of your spells.
Spend 1 sorcery point to gain resistance to cold damage for 1 hour.

sheet.description: When you cast a spell that deals cold damage, add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll. You can spend 1 sorcery point to gain resistance to cold damage for 1 hour.

description.p: Reroll damage dice up to CHA modifier.
You can treat immunity as resistance a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

sheet.description: Cold damage ignores resistance. Reroll damage (CHA mod dice). Break immunity → resistance PB/LR.

description.p: You choose the silver dragon as your ancestor. The cold damage type is used by features you gain later.

sheet.description: The silver dragon as your ancestor.
